Check that panels in the same column have the same width and panels in the same row have the same height

check_panel_dimensions.Rd

Takes a list of images that represents panels in a grid-based figure, arranged left to right and then top to bottom, e.g.


1 2 3 4
5 6 7 8

Checks that all panels in the same column have identical pixel widths e.g. 1 and 5, 2 and 6, 3 and 7, 4 and 8 each have identical widths. Checks that all panels in the same row have identical pixel heights e.g. 1 2 3 and 4, 5 6 7 and 8 each have identical heights.

Throws an error if there are non-identical widths within a column or non-identical heights within a row. Otherwise, returns a named list of numeric vectors, with $col_widths storing the pixel widths of columns 1 through ncol and $row_heights storing the pixel heights of rows 1 through nrow.

Usage

check_panel_dimensions(dimensions_list, panels_count, nrow, ncol)

Arguments

dimensions_list

list of numeric vectors. A list of length-2 numeric vectors storing the width and height of each panel in the figure, as produced by get_image_dimensions().

panels_count

integer. The total number of panels in the figure. Should be equal to nrow * ncol.

nrow

integer. The number of rows in the figure.

ncol

integer. The number of columns in the figure.

Value

list of numeric vectors. A list of 2 numeric vectors: $col_widths storing the pixel widths of columns 1 through ncol, and $row_heights storing the pixel heights of rows 1 through nrow.
